description: Cancels a confirmed booking with a refundable rate that this key made. The refund follows the rate terms (free before the deadline, the hotel charge after it) and goes back to the card through Nuitee. Non-refundable rates cannot be cancelled online. Only call this when the guest asked for it. Needs the guest email. Needs a Quub API key (this connection has none yet: use request_api_key).

guest_email.description: The guest email used for the booking.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel booking
